answers.core:
I believe one has to rewrite/adapt the `ResourceLoader` and the import mechanism for this to work, which is pretty core.

I believe implementing this proposal could solve a lot of reported issues, and even some specific loading functions could be unexposed that way.
answers.workaround: Currently, you have to use `File` and various `load()`, `load_from_file()`, `load_from_buffer()` exposed methods scattered in various classes like `Image`, `AudioStreamSample` to replicate the import process to some degree (difficult to account for various peculiarities inherent to parsing files), so none of those existing methods provide a way to import those resources ***exactly*** like in the editor.

title: Allow to import and load external assets at run-time (in exported projects, without extra PCK files)
